name: Set vehicle classifications
title: Set vehicle classifications
description:
Review the seeded vehicle types and add the classifications needed by movement analysis. Keep the taxonomy mutually understandable to operators (for example, passenger car, van, bus, bicycle, heavy goods vehicle); mark each active/inactive deliberately. Use illustrations only when you have rights to use them.

Vehicle Type is a reference record; the individual CAM Vehicle record stores the operational identity and any image. Avoid creating a type for every individual make/model unless that distinction is actually used in analysis.
